purpose: Teach: 曲目/新曲/雑音/緻密/ロッカー/似顔絵/起こる/ちがい

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの好きな歌の、絶対、曲目、絶対、これだよ
lines.en: Mom, this is definitely my favorite song — like, seriously.
lines.style: Bright, insistent emphasis on 「絶対」. Quick, breathless delivery as if tumbling over the words. Small-child certainty with genuine urgency underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃の歌手の、絶対、新曲、絶対、好きなのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your father really does love those singers from his younger days, you know, Sho. Their new songs especially.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. A slight knowing smile in the voice — gently amused by the comparison Sho has drawn. Relaxed pace, maternal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お家の、絶対、雑音、絶対、テレビかな?本気で
lines.en: Mom, is that noise from the house coming from the TV, do you think? I'm serious about that.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely puzzled. Quiet observation — not demanding an answer, but noticing something and checking in. Thoughtful pause before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、緻密、絶対、な絵、絶対、ママ、絶対、感心するわ
lines.en: You know, the detailed drawings you do, Sho — Mom is really impressed by them.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration. Open, unhurried pace. Slight emphasis on 「緻密」equivalent, as if seeing the care in the work. Tender but not patronizing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、駅の、絶対、ロッカー、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、使ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I actually used the locker at the station with Dad. I'm telling you for real.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, sharing something small that felt important enough to mention. Steady, honest delivery. A child's sense of 「important enough to report back.」

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、似顔絵、絶対、ママの机に、絶対、飾ってあるわよ
lines.en: And I've got your portrait of me right there on my desk at work, you know.
lines.style: Affectionate, intimate. Quiet pride underneath. As if Sho has just touched something she's been keeping close. Unhurried, genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、雷が、絶対、起こる、絶対、と、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、恐いよ
lines.en: Mom, when thunder happens — I get a little scared, honestly. I really do.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerability beneath the 「本気で」. Not dramatic, not minimizing it either. Small, truthful admission. Slight hesitation, as if checking if it's okay to say.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんと、本気で、絶対、ママの、絶対、考えの、絶対、ちがい、絶対、いつでも、絶対、話し合いましょうね
lines.en: You and I think differently sometimes, Sho, but we can always talk about it whenever you need to, okay?
lines.style: Steady, patient reassurance. Unhurried. The kind of thing a mother says when she means it completely. Gentle but clear, with quiet conviction underneath.
